text:
Eden L: noticed confusion in the 'Change region' flow. the CTA and small KMS note make it look like keys move with data. customers keep DMing support.
Marcus H: big issue. we need to surface two things separately: retention effect and KMS portability. current sentence 'Encryption keys may be affected' is too vague.
Rhea T: suggestion for modal layout: title 'Change workspace region' short lead: 'Moving your workspace can affect where data is stored and which encryption keys are available.' two-column area: left = retention (current value + target default + short note), right = KMS status (badge + short sentence + action link).
Jonas K: mobile will break with two columns. prefer stacked sections with compact headings. also keep all actionable buttons in the footer.
Eden L: copy proposals for KMS status: 'Customer KMS: not available in target region' vs 'Customer KMS cannot be used in eu-central1'. which is clearer?
Marcus H: prefer 'cannot be used in <region>' 14 it's explicit. include tooltip: 'Keys are region-bound. Upload a new key or choose platform-managed encryption.'
Rhea T: a11y: tooltip must be keyboard focusable and tied via aria-describedby. modal needs focus trap and role="dialog" with aria-modal. ensure warning text has semantic markup and not only color.
Jonas K: audit log entry idea: short machine text and a human string. machine: 'event:region_change, actor:Eden L, from:us-west1, to:eu-central1, retention:overridden, kms:unavailable' human: 'Eden L moved workspace phoenix from us-west1 to eu-central1; retention set to 30 days; customer KMS unavailable.'
Infra Bot: staging preview of updated modal + audit sample deployed at 1850012400
Eden L: one more nit: when user has custom retention, show 'Keep current retention' checkbox. If not selected, show explicit line: 'Retention will default to 30 days in eu-central1.' don't imply auto-reversion without consent.
Marcus H: final: ticket should include short copy, extended copy, accessibility checklist, contrast swatches for warning states, audit log formats, and mobile stacking rules. tagging @Rhea T for copy signoff and @Jonas K for mobile layout estimates. :white_check_mark:
